status_rationale: All publicly available Evolent 2026 governing clinical guidelines, place-of-service policies, clinical decision tip sheets, conservative treatment documentation forms, and prior authorization checklists have been collected and verified. Individual commercial/Medicare Advantage health plans may have specific authorization waiver thresholds or customized crosswalks, but the national clinical baseline published by Evolent is 100% complete.

The full pair of 2026 governing clinical guidelines (Diagnostic Cardiology and Interventional Cardiology) along with the official 2026 Cardiovascular Service Group CPT Grid, cardiac unbundling claim edits, intake checklists, and 6 procedure-specific tip sheets have been collected and verified.

The comprehensive 225-page 2026 governing clinical guideline, the 2026 Place of Service Policy EPOS 1773, spine and joint surgery checklists, 5 commercial and Medicare clinical tip sheets, and both Back/Neck and Major Joint conservative treatment history forms are fully collected.

The 2026 governing clinical guideline (102 pages), Place of Service Policy EPOS 1755, retained 2025 guideline (75 pages), clinical intake checklist, provider tip sheet, and both current and historical conservative treatment forms have been gathered and verified.

Both official clinical guidelines (ECG 7000 for Radiation Therapy Services and ECG 7001 for Proton/Neutron Beam Therapy), the January 2026 Coding Standards policy, and all 6 tumor-specific prior authorization checklists (Breast, Prostate, Non-Small Cell Lung, CNS Primary, Colon/Rectal, Head & Neck) are gathered and verified.

The 2026 governing physical medicine clinical guideline (143 pages), all 8 core supplementary clinical policies (Active Procedures, Passive Modalities, Measurable Progressive Improvement, Habilitative PT/OT, Speech Therapy, DME, Experimental/Unproven Services, Record Keeping Standards), both tip sheets, and member attestation forms are fully gathered.
The governing 2026 Sleep Studies Clinical Guideline along with both standard and plan-specific (attended study without HST benefit) clinical intake checklists are fully collected and verified.

The current governing 2026 Genetic Testing Clinical Guidelines (174 pages), the October 2026 master Genetic Tests and Laboratory Matrix (60 pages), generic intake checklist, and the Concert Genetics Oncology Molecular Analysis tumor biomarker guideline (55 pages) are fully collected and verified.

The current governing 2026 clinical policy CP.MP.107 (Revision 08/26, 24 pages), the historical seed policy (Revision 11/24, 21 pages), all 7 directly referenced procedure-specific policies (CP.MP.48, CP.MP.99, CP.MP.173, CP.MP.184, CP.MP.185, CP.MP.203, CP.MP.243), and all 4 cited external statutory and clinical standards (CMS Claims Manual Ch 20, State Operations Manual App A, DMEPOS Quality Standards, RESNA Seat Elevation Position Paper) have been gathered and verified.
